Anant Singh ki chhoti beti Shivangi Singh in dinon apni shadi ko lekar charcha men hain. 25 navanbar ko unki shadi rishikesh kumar urph ankit kumar se hone vali hai. Shivangi Singh ne dilli ki Amity University se grejueshan kiya hai, jabki unke hone vale pati ne amerika ki Georgia State University se MBA kiya hai. aakhir kaun hain shivangi sinh, kya karte hain unke hone vale pati aur kaisa hai unka parivar? janie is khas riport men...
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
